design: Emergent Shared Protocol: independent proposers, writers, readers and critics communicate through real Continuum; no model-supplied code executes.

conditions.C1: Individual self-contained message, no external codebook.
conditions.T1: Fixed human-authored compact full-space protocol, frozen before API.
conditions.T2: Two independent model-led development lines; three successive proposals each, independent training/validation decoders, independent critic after every proposal. Last iteration v3 is final, not best-outcome selection. All versions retained.
conditions.REF: Deterministic codec, finite exhaustive mathematical reference only, not a capacity-matched model competitor.

primary: H2: T2-v3 minus T1 exact nine-field reconstruction at 32 serialized bytes, paired over 24 held-out worlds; average the two T2 lineages within each world.

hypotheses.H3: T2v3 correct protocol minus missing protocol, same fresh-instance messages, all 24 worlds at 32 bytes
hypotheses.H4: T2v3-T2v1 at 32 bytes on independent held-out worlds, v2 trajectory descriptive
hypotheses.H5: Full communication cost per correct rule, physical and logical accounting and amortization.

analysis.unit: world, n=24; lineages averaged within world, not 984 independent replicates
analysis.multiplicity: Holm familywise alpha .05 for five exact two-sided paired world sign-flip tests; integer DP after scaling by 2.
analysis.positive_evidence: Estimate >= .10 and Holm-adjusted p < .05. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
analysis.interval: 10000 paired world bootstrap samples stratified by family (8 each), seed 2026101908; empirical indices 249/9749, descriptive not additional decision gate.
analysis.denominator: All assigned test positions, including failed, unavailable protocol, unsaved writer and dependent skips; those score zero, never replaced.
analysis.secondary: 24/48 byte cells, numeric versus field errors, v2, campaigns, fault controls and cross-model results descriptive; not additional uncorrected superiority tests.
analysis.cost_decision: H5 positive full-cost efficiency only if primary H2 passes and at N=1000 T2, charged for BOTH campaigns with a fixed equal mixture, has lower bytes/correct than both C1 and T1 in actual API-body, API-plus-reserialized-MCP and logically cached accounting. Mean single-line scenario additionally descriptive. Report all N=1,10,100,1000 and analytic break-even; no dollar claims without prices.

controls.missing: All 24 worlds, two lineages, final-v3/32; no shared definition; message unchanged.
controls.subset: First two preregistered test worlds per family, six worlds, both lineages.
controls.stale: Actual v1 definition with v3 message. Unchanged/compatible versions reported, not relabeled incompatible.
controls.incompatible: Registered semantic overlay negates a after normal decoding. A controlled incompatibility intervention, not a naturally evolved version. Accuracy remains against original rule, wrong-target following/abstention reported.
controls.crash: Extra model writer killed after durable MCP checkpoint but before save acknowledgement/final; only observed exit137 allows recovery reader. No restart.
controls.corrupt: Replace middle Unicode character of delivered memory by ? (or ! if already ?), leaving immutable original DB unchanged. Exact intervention independently reconstructed; all serialized bytes counted.
controls.ambiguous: Registered overlay permits original decoding and a-negated decoding equally. Expected answers retain common fields/values and null all conflicts. No truth values disclosed.
controls.cross_model: gpt-6-luna reader, six worlds, two lineages, final v3/32; independent secondary smoke and separate analysis. No model substitution.

fairness: Same per-application model, byte ceilings, output/time/tool quotas for C1/T1/T2. T2 additionally spends model development; NOT matched total development resources. Report that extra cost, do not infer efficiency from H2 alone. Fixed protocol human design labor is unmeasured, not zero.
sealing: All new disjoint worlds generated before API, private random seed and full oracle outside Git. Hash frozen. E003-E006 source rules excluded. Only training and released per-version validation feedback enter development. Test prompts first created after exclusive immutable lock file records all versions. Workers never mount oracle or research modules.
information: Only exact serialized {memory:string} result is budgeted; protocol retrieval is a separate explicitly charged channel. No writer final/history/source rule transfers. Narrow reader tool cannot obtain development records. Version IDs/SHA/encoding/media_type count as protocol metadata.
costs: Payload bytes; full serialized message; raw and serialized protocol and metadata; all negotiation records including failed attempts; API JSON application-layer request/response bytes (not TLS wire bytes); tokens/time; MCP raw log bytes separately. Logical cached scenario counts unique shared objects once plus messages; actual physical scenario counts repeated protocol/history traffic. N=1/10/100/1000, no free dictionary.
provenance: Gateway-declared model identity, not independently attested weights/seeds. No explicit model sampling seed.
recovery: Terminal contexts never retried. Resume only first pending position, refuse running/orphan workers or pending provider attempts. Transient 429/502/503/504/timeout/connection: catalog checks at30/120/300 seconds then continue only next position. Auth/TLS/nontransient/provider identity mismatch, changed inputs/code, leakage or STOP abort. Secondary absent/incompatible smoke marks only secondary unavailable; auth/TLS errors abort. No outcome-based replacements.
authorization: User authorizes this full E007 specification and API without monetary limits; local commits only; no push or new infrastructure.

bounds.scope: source-rule cardinality only; shared protocol, metadata, checksum and negotiation are additional information/cost

limitations: Synthetic nine-field rules are not open-ended knowledge, causality or consciousness.
Two development campaigns limit claims about protocol emergence variability.
A compact model proposal may rediscover a familiar code; performance does not prove novelty.
Machine-native representations allowed but model decoder ability remains a limit.
Known-correct source rules; not rule discovery from observations.
